"''Alert General Hux. And stop that fighter!|Petty officer Thanisson and Colonel Kaplan|audio=KaplanThanisson.flac|}} '''Kaplan''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[colonel]] in the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], Kaplan was posted in a control room in [[Hangar Six]] on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'' when it traveled to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in order to try and recover a portion of the [[Map to Skywalker|map]] showing the location of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. After the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] was brought on board the ''Finalizer'' for [[Torture|questioning]], he and the defecting [[First Order stormtrooper]] [[Finn|FN-2187]] [[Escape from the Finalizer|stole]] a [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]] from [[Hangar]] Six in an attempt to escape. As the [[starfighter]] was still connected to its support cable, it was unable to leave the hangar after taking off, and Kaplan was alerted to the escape attempt by [[Petty Officer]] [[Thanisson]]. While Dameron attempted to disconnect the support cabling, FN-2187 blasted the main control room where Kaplan and Thanisson were positioned, killing them both. However, the [[TIE series|TIE]] fighter sustained damage while escaping and crashed on Jakku. ==Biography== ===Mission to Jakku=== [[File:TFA_FirstOrder_Star_Destroyer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kaplan was stationed on board the ''Finalizer''.]] Kaplan was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[First Order military|military branch]] of the [[First Order]] during their [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]], an offshoot of the [[New Republic]]. In [[34 ABY]], Kaplan held the rank of [[colonel]] and was stationed on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'',''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' where they were posted in the main control room for [[Hangar Six]]. Kaplan was on board the ''Finalizer'' when it traveled to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in the [[Jakku system]]''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' in search of the retired [[Scout|explorer]] [[Lor San Tekka]], who held a piece of a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] to the location of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. After the First Order [[Attack on Tuanul|deployed]] forces to San Tekka's home village of [[Tuanul]], the explorer was [[Death|killed]] and the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] was captured; however, the map was spirited away by Dameron's [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]], whom the First Order failed to capture. ===An unauthorized departure from Bay Two=== {{Quote|Fourteen failed. Eighteen—|A report given in Kaplan's control center shortly before its explosion|audio=FourteenFailedEighteen.flac|}} [[File:Hangar_Six_control_room.png|thumb|right|250px|The control room Kaplan was stationed in was destroyed during FN-2187 and Poe Dameron's escape attempt.]] Dameron was brought on board the ''Finalizer'' for [[Torture|interrogation]], but as the hunt for BB-8 began, the [[pilot]] was [[Escape from the Finalizer|freed]] by [[Finn|FN-2187]], a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] hoping to defect from the First Order. The [[trooper]] brought Dameron into Hangar Six under the pretense of escorting the [[prisoner]] and then hurriedly boarded one of the [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s in [[Bay Two]] of the hangar. When the pair attempted to take off, they discovered the [[starfighter]]'s support cabling was still attached, preventing their escape and drawing the attention of [[Petty Officer]] [[Thanisson]] in the control room. Thanisson immediately reported the unsanctioned departure to Kaplan, who ordered that the [[TIE series|TIE]] be stopped from escaping while [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]],''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' head of the First Order's military, be alerted. [[Squad]]s of stormtroopers carrying [[F-11D blaster rifle]]s and [[FWMB-10 repeating blaster]]s then attempted to shoot down the starfighter, but were unsuccessful as FN-2187 used the vehicle's [[Lb-14 dual heavy laser turret]] to blast many of them. The trooper then turned the [[turret]] on the control room, shattering the [[Viewport|windows]] in an explosion that threw Thanisson from his seat. Kaplan and the other [[First Order officer|officers]] present tried to cower away from the blast, but both the colonel and Thanisson were killed. Once Dameron managed to disconnect the support cabling, the fighter escaped from the ''Finalizer'' and headed for Jakku, but was shot down by the [[battlecruiser]] en route and crashed on the planet's surface. ==Personality and traits== Kaplan was fair-skinned and [[Color|gray]]-[[eye]]d. They shared their surname with a famous [[Kaplan (Imperial)|warlord]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] whose name First Order colonels wore on commemorative bands. Kaplan spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]] with an aristocratic accent. ==Equipment== Kaplan wore a teal [[First Order military uniforms|First Order military uniform]] including a [[Hat|cap]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Get me communications with that vessel. Alert ship command, notify General Hux, and stop that fighter!|Kaplan's slightly altered line of dialogue in the novelization|}} Kaplan was portrayed by [[Pip Torrens]] in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. They were identified in the credits. Kaplan shares their name with [[Michael Kaplan]], the film's costume designer. The character also appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|novelization]] of the film written by [[Alan Dean Foster]] and released in conjunction with the film,{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}} in which their single line of dialogue is slightly altered. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 1|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|73|Starship Fact File}} *''[[Sutā Wōzu Fōsu No Kakusei No Nakamatachi 100]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Kaplan (Erste Ordnung)#kanon |es=Kaplan (coronel) |fi=Kaplan (eversti) |fr=Kaplan |ja=カプラン（ファースト・オーダー） |ka=კაპლანი (პოლკოვნიკი) }} [[Category:Colonels]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Officers of the First Order]]
